source.rationale: Two pool entries, ONE company name: the Set dedupe collapses them, so names[] is length 1, the `Both` lead does not fire, and the company parenthetical invites the ONE deduped name (D5 - which still resolves: the parser pools by lowercased name, so both rows are one pool key). Also covers the routing_companies fallback - routing_roster_plan is present but empty, so `pools` falls through to routing_companies. clarify-company-gate is a pass-through If: the item is escalation-context's output, which is where routing_source === 'multi_company_unpicked' was decided. offer-hold-reply and clarify-company-reply run the SAME body (asserted byte-identical by tests/unit/offer-hold-clarify-copy.test.js), so this case is mirrored onto both.
